name: superstack
description: superstack: where your goals, corrections, and evidence live across every session, with gates that fire at the chokepoints whether or not a skill loads.

plugins.name: superstack
plugins.description: Long-horizon work with a coding agent keeps losing its goal: sessions go cold, context compacts, and a new session rebuilds the project from guesses. superstack keeps a per-workspace record (git-ignored, plain text) of your goals, corrections minted as standing doctrine, the calibration record of every done-claim, campaign plans with their frontier, and parked work, surfaced at every session start. Shell hooks fire on harness events whether or not a skill loads: completion claims are bounced once until they carry a Verified/Assumed/PROVISIONAL evidence ledger, a look-step is asked for when a changed artifact has a face, publish commands wait for a fresh go-public sweep receipt, a prompt-time door offers shaping when a raw idea arrives, and the goal survives compaction. Every gate bounces once, logs, and lets an identical retry through, except the destructive publish tier (the infra applies and registry publishes), where the retry waits for a one-line grant file you write, consumed on use; that is calibration pressure on the model's claims and a record of your authorization, never access control. Behind the spine sits a bench of specialist skills covering the engineering lifecycle from idea shaping through release, routed by description or called directly by slash command. Zero residue, and no dependency on any other plugin or skill.
